data.body: Pointer (2026-09-07): the complexity-reduction session that produced the breaking-pass-4 epics now has its own consolidated session log, rockbound-filched-tench (10ae-1ef7-97c9-4645): charter and the 21 proposals, operator rulings and the deprecation census, research records, the epic and story ledger, the baseline-maintenance decision and bug 1768, experiments and the cross-epic overlap analysis, plan-review rounds (all four land-first stories certified), the blocking-bug list, the gate and janitor analysis (idea doomed-soldierly-slothbear 77e3-28e2-31ec-47ec), process notes and open items. The six earlier entries this session left here (comments 161, 163, 184, 219, 220, 235) are superseded by that log.
